def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # normalize sex case variants (MALE/FEMALE -> male/female), keep NaN as unknown
    if 'sex' in df.columns:
        df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype('object')
        df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # body_mass_g is text with commas e.g. "3,075" -> numeric
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    # flipper_length_mm: coerce text numbers, fix sign errors (-200 -> 200, -187 -> 187)
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
        # negative values are sign errors, take absolute value
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
        # enforce allowed range 170-235, set out-of-range to NaN (after abs the two negatives become valid)
        df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    # average flipper_length_mm per species
    # drop rows with missing species key
    d = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    # ensure numeric
    d['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(d['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    grouped = d.groupby('species', dropna=True)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items() if pd.notna(k) and pd.notna(v)}
